title: ScholarChain experiment manifest, format v1
description: One bounded experiment run by scripts/run-experiment.sh. No schema validator is installed: the runner checks only the rules marked 'enforced by run-experiment.sh: yes' in experiments/README.md, with jq. Every other rule here is documentation only. A manifest never holds a secret, an account ID, an ARN with an account ID, a queue URL or a literal bucket name; S3 locations are logical (s3://{data-bucket}/KEY).

manifestId.description: Lowercase letters, digits and '-'; starts with a letter or digit; at most 64 characters. Equals the file name without '.json' (enforced by the runner; JSON Schema cannot express it). Unique across experiments/manifests/ (documentation only).

example.description: true marks a format example; the runner always refuses it. Enforced.

experiment.description: The specification's Phase 15 experiment: A Hadoop and Spark baseline, B Hadoop and Spark burst, C embedding backlog, D query load, E retrieval modes, F failure and recovery. Enforced.

description.description: What the run measures and why. Enforced: non-empty string.

datasetSnapshot.description: Dataset snapshot and subset rule the run reads, as named in datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml. Enforced: non-empty string.

costBoundUsd.description: Declared cost bound in USD. Enforced: a number greater than 0 and not above the runner's hard per-run cap of 5 USD. A declaration: nothing measures spend during a run.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Bounds only the local runner (timeout). Remote work keeps running and is bounded by Terraform (state machine timeout, EMR managed-scaling maximum, idle end). Enforced: integer greater than 0.

resourceLimits.description: Recorded, not applied: the real caps are the Terraform values. Enforced: an object. Its keys are documentation only; the recommended keys are listed below, others are allowed.

terraformSource.description: Where the enforced cap lives, for example 'infra/terraform/modules/emr/variables.tf managed_scaling_max_units'.

action.description: What the runner starts. Enforced: kind is 'pipeline' or 'command'; for 'command', path starts with 'load-tests/' or 'experiments/collectors/' and has no '..' segment; args is an array of strings.

args.description: Arguments passed unchanged to scripts/run-bounded-pipeline.sh, as its usage text at the manifest's commit defines them.

path.description: A committed executable under load-tests/ or experiments/collectors/, relative to the repository root.

metrics.description: CloudWatch metric queries the runner exports for the run window plus 5 minutes on each side. Enforced: an array. The shape of each item is documentation only; a malformed query makes the export fail, which the runner records as 'succeeded-metrics-failed'.

dimensions.description: Name and value pairs. A value is a literal without account ID, or a placeholder in braces (for example '{emr-cluster-id}', '{state-machine-arn}') that the runner resolves at run time.

stat.description: A CloudWatch statistic, for example Sum, Average, Maximum, Minimum, SampleCount, p50, p95, p99.

notes.description: Optional free text (limitations, links to the gate that approved the manifest).
